transcript: When I arrived at the station, my friend had already departed on his train I caught my breath and sat down on the bench, feeling exhausted Actually, I had left home late, the road had been under repair for some time And I had not known the detour Meanwhile my friend had reached station on time The staff said he had boarded the train only a few minutes before I had not been able to spot his face in the crowd I felt sorry, but there was nothing I could do I had to wait for the next train, then my phone rang He would get off at the next station and come back for me I realize now that he has always shown this gentle kindness On a small bench in front of the station, I sat waiting for him My feelings eventually settled, the clouds vanished And eventually the sky grew bright

segments.text: When I arrived at the station, my friend had already departed on his train
I caught my breath and sat down on the bench, feeling exhausted
Actually, I had left home late, the road had been under repair for some time
And I had not known the detour
Meanwhile my friend had reached station on time
The staff said he had boarded the train only a few minutes before
I had not been able to spot his face in the crowd
I felt sorry, but there was nothing I could do
I had to wait for the next train, then my phone rang
He would get off at the next station and come back for me
I realize now that he has always shown this gentle kindness
On a small bench in front of the station, I sat waiting for him
My feelings eventually settled, the clouds vanished
And eventually the sky grew bright
